yt_title: The 27th Amendment Took 202 Years To Pass #Shorts
desc: The 27th Amendment took two hundred two years to be ratified, from seventeen eighty-nine to nineteen ninety-two. It is the longest wait of any amendment. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Two centuries of waiting! 🏛️ Did you know this? Follow for a fact every day. Send this to someone who loves history. Comment YES or NO.

lines.text: One amendment took two hundred two years to pass.
It was proposed in seventeen eighty-nine, alongside the Bill of Rights.
Twelve amendments were sent to the states. Ten passed in seventeen ninety-one.
One of the stalled two, about congressional pay, was finally ratified in nineteen ninety-two.
That is the longest wait for any amendment: two hundred two years.
